verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated webhooks documentation page stating that webhooks let you react to process events, sandbox lifecycle changes, and file modifications. That is a first-party outbound event-subscription capability covering several event types. The evidence is a single summary line, so the details of how subscriptions work are not shown. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription API or config, payload schema and delivery/retry/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
